jobs.title: Director, Ecommerce and Marketing Analytics
jobs.description:
With 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food.

Sur La Table is seeking a Director, Ecommerce and Marketing Analytics
to define how data, insight, and AI drive decision-making across the company.

This role serves as the analytical hub of the organization
, supporting eCommerce, Marketing, Finance, Retail, Merchandising, Inventory Planning, and Operations. While embedded within the eCommerce organization, the mandate of this role is company-wide: to transform data into insight, insight into implications, and implications into clear recommendations that drive action.

This is not a reporting role. It is a foundational leadership role responsible for establishing analytical standards, governing AI-enabled workflows, ensuring data integrity, and elevating how decisions are made across the business.

This position will report into the Senior Director of Ecommerce.

What you get to do:

Company-Wide Insight Leadership

Serve as the primary analytics leader across eCommerce, Marketing, Finance, Retail, Merchandising, Inventory Planning, and Operations.
Own problem definition for analytics - determining which business questions matter and what decisions insights should inform.
Move analysis beyond “what happened” to “why it happened,” “how it happened,” and “what we should do next.”
Proactively mine data to identify risks, opportunities, inefficiencies, and performance drivers.
Influence senior leaders through clear implications and actionable recommendations.

Data Integrity, Metrics & Standards

Own the integrity, governance, and usability of core commerce, customer, and operational datasets across platforms (eCommerce, POS, CDP, email, data warehouse).
Validate insights using business context and commercial logic — not just technical correctness.
Define, document, and continuously evolve company-wide KPI frameworks in partnership with Finance and functional leaders.
Identify and resolve cross-functional metric misalignment to ensure a single, trusted understanding of performance.
Establish standards for data quality, documentation, and analytical transparency across the organization.

AI-Enabled Analytics & Insight Workflows

Leverage AI as a core component of advanced analytical work, including hypothesis generation, exploratory analysis, pattern detection, insight synthesis, and narrative development.
Design, operationalize, and scale repeatable AI-assisted workflows that support recurring company-level decisions (growth, margin optimization, inventory productivity, forecast alignment).
Establish validation frameworks to pressure-test AI-generated outputs against source data, historical performance, customer behavior, and commercial logic.
Embed AI-enabled insights into planning, forecasting, and executive performance reviews.
Promote responsible, explainable, and outcome-driven AI usage across analytics workflows.

Web, Customer & Commerce Analytics (Heap)

Own web and digital analytics strategy using Heap, including funnel performance, customer journey analysis, and conversion optimization.
Ensure tracking integrity and event schema accuracy, including review of structured data formats (e.g., JSON, data layers) in partnership with Product Engineering.
Translate behavioral data into commercial implications that influence merchandising, marketing, inventory, and operational decisions.
Ensure behavioral insights are aligned with downstream systems and financial realities.

Cross-Functional Integration

Reconcile demand, margin, inventory, and operational perspectives into cohesive performance narratives.
Support planning, forecasting, and performance alignment across Finance, Retail, Merchandising, and Operations.
Challenge assumptions and reframe business narratives using data-backed insight.
Serve as a connector between commercial strategy and operational execution.

Leadership & Enablement

Establish analytical standards that prioritize clarity, trust, commercial relevance, and decision impact.
Reduce reactive ad hoc work by building scalable, decision-focused reporting and automation frameworks.
Design the structure, workflows, and expectations for the analytics function.
Hire, mentor, and develop junior analytics talent once foundational systems are established.
Champion a modern, insight-driven analytics culture across the company.

What you bring:

8+ years of experience in Analytics, Strategy, or Data Leadership roles.
Demonstrated experience leading analytics across multiple business functions.
Strong experience in commerce-driven businesses (retail, eCommerce, CPG, marketplace).
Comprehensive knowledge of all traffic acquisition channels and their downstream impact on site behavior, using that expertise to develop reliable forecasts that drive strategic decision-making.
Advanced SQL and strong analytical modeling capabilities.
Demonstrated experience designing and governing AI-enabled analytics workflows.
Strong capability to pressure-test AI-generated insights against data, customer behavior, and commercial logic.
Hands-on expertise with Heap or similar event-based web analytics platforms.
Comfort working with structured data formats (e.g., JSON), event schemas, and data instrumentation.
Experience defining KPI frameworks and resolving cross-functional metric misalignment.
Proven ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling stories that inform and influence executive decision-making - moving leadership from insight to action with confidence and conviction.
Track record of proactive insight generation, not reactive reporting
Ability to work standard Eastern Time business hours

What’s in it for you? Joining Sur La Table isn’t just about having a seat at the table—it’s about helping redesign the table entirely. You’ll be challenged, stretched, and supported as you grow faster than you thought possible. In addition to competitive compensation, we offer:

Executive Access: Work directly with brand CEOs and senior leadership, solving real business problems and earning mentorship from top operators.
AI-First Skill Building: Get hands-on with the most advanced AI tools in the market. From automation to prompt engineering, you’ll build a modern tech stack that sets you apart in any industry.
Accelerated Career Path: High performers are quickly entrusted with greater responsibility, new challenges, and leadership opportunities across our portfolio of brands.
Competitive benefits: Paid time off policies, 401(k)/RRSP match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts at our portfolio companies.
Salary: $130,000 - $145,000 plus bonus

Our interview process:

📞 Step 1: If you align with our vision and meet the qualifications, we’ll reach out to schedule a conversation and introduce Sur La Table.
🧠 Step 2: You’ll complete a short AI or product-building challenge so we can understand how you approach problems and execution.
💬 Step 3: Participate in deep-dive interviews with Sur La Table leadership focused on your experience, product mindset, and operational thinking.
📩 Step 4: Offer. We’ll move fast for the right candidate.

$130,000 - $145,000 a year

Salary range is $130,000 - $145,000 plus bonus

up to $250,000, dependent on experience
Employment:
Permanent | Full-time

Legal & Professional Services

Ingenio is supporting a leading international law firm with the appointment of a Global Head of Digital Strategy & Transformation
.

This is a senior leadership position reporting directly to the Global Chief Operating Officer, with significant exposure to the Board and wider executive leadership team. The successful candidate will lead the firm's digital transformation strategy, bringing together business applications, data, AI, automation and digital client services to deliver measurable business improvements.

This is not a traditional IT infrastructure or operational technology role. An established CTO is responsible for those areas. The focus of this appointment is on strategy, development, transformation and execution
.

The Opportunity
You will take responsibility for developing and delivering a global digital transformation strategy across legal, corporate and trust services. Working with senior business stakeholders, you will turn commercial and operational challenges into practical technology solutions that improve efficiency, client experience and service delivery.

You'll inherit an established application development team and will be responsible for developing its capabilities as the transformation programme progresses.

Significant projects are already underway, including a major entity-management platform initiative, a broader data management and analytics programme, and opportunities to extend the use of AI and automation across the business.

Key Responsibilities
Develop and deliver a global digital strategy and transformation roadmap aligned with business priorities.
Lead and develop the existing Business Technology and Application Development team.
Own the business applications roadmap, including entity management and client-facing technology solutions.
Oversee the design, development and delivery of new systems, whether built internally, purchased or delivered through external partners.
Drive the data strategy, analytics, reporting and business intelligence agenda.
Identify and implement practical AI and automation opportunities across legal and professional services.

What We're Looking For
We are particularly interested in senior digital transformation and business technology leaders from professional services, legal, fiduciary/corporate services, financial services or similarly complex, regulated environments
.

You will bring:
Significant experience leading digital strategy, business technology or enterprise transformation.
A proven track record of delivering complex technology programmes with measurable business outcomes.
Strong experience across business applications, software development and technology-enabled process improvement.
A solid understanding of data strategy, analytics, business intelligence, AI and automation.
Experience leading multidisciplinary development teams and managing external delivery partners.
The ability to influence Board-level stakeholders while remaining technically credible and close to delivery.

Location & Package
Toronto is the mandatory location, with this being an in-office role.

Interested?
This is an opportunity to shape the digital direction of an established international professional services organisation, with direct access to senior leadership, an existing development capability and significant transformation programmes already underway.

For a confidential discussion, please contact Michelle Queally at Ingenio
, or apply directly.

jobs.title: Director, Supply Chain Canada
jobs.description:
Job Description

About us

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, we’re the world’s leading premium drinks company. From global icons like Johznnie Walker, Guinness and Tanqueray to Smirnoff and Don Julio, we create brands consumers love. Bring your passion and use your curiosity as you explore, collaborate and innovate. Together with passionate people from all over the world, you’ll test new ideas, learn and grow, and unlock a brighter, more exciting future.

Join us to create a career worth celebrating.

About The Function

Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world.

With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships.

It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.

Position Title: Supply Director, Canada

Location: Dunwin Drive, Toronto, Canada

Reports to: VP Supply Chain Canada

About The Role

Seeking an experienced Supply Chain professional to lead Canadian Supply Operations and drive the change needed to support Diageo Canada's ambitions with evolving customers and consumer needs.

The ideal candidate will have proven ability to lead change within supply chain operations and a strong track record of delivering against strategic objectives while maintaining high standards of execution.

They will have experience managing multiple supply chain functions with a focus on both execution and continuous improvement, as well as exceptional leadership skills with the ability to influence cross functional teams and partners.

The successful candidate will lead key Canadian Supply functions, including:

Customer Operations, VAP (Value Added Packaging), Demand & Supply Planning, Bailment Inventory Planning, and Ontario Keg Operations

Beer Distribution. They will also orchestrate supply chain dependencies across Logistics, Conversion, Innovation, and Finance.

Supply is a critical element to market success and this position will be expected to offer partnership and thought leadership to the expanded Canadian Leadership team.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership Responsibility:

Provide Supply Chain Leadership for the Canadian business and your team, this role represents Supply as part of the Canadian Leadership Team. In addition to having a voice in the execution of annual plans, you will be expected to help shape the culture of Team Canada and provide an amplified leadership across the wider Canadian organization and North American Supply team.

Management Responsibility

4 Direct reports with a total team of 40+ (combination of salaried & hourly team members)

Site lead to Dunwin Keg warehouse and delivery for the entire Ontario region

Keys To Success

Ensure continuity of supply and efficient interaction of all Demand and Supply elements for Canada.
Lead cross-functional strategic programs aimed at improving the total supply chain.
Communicate proactively with all key partners regarding the status of the Canadian Supply Chain.
Upgrade competencies within the group and organization.
Develop and implement optimized Canadian supply chain strategies in collaboration with wider North America Supply.
Build effective partnerships with Liquor Boards, Government, and trade bodies.
Sponsor strategic projects aimed at improving customer service levels, reducing operating costs, or decreasing order fulfillment lead-time.

Complexities Of Role

Ontario Guinness KEGs – lead all operational aspects of KEG warehousing and delivery in Ontario (including P&L management, Customer Service desk, LCBO relationship, Compliance and Health & Safety)
Champion the embedding of Integrated Business Planning (IBP) with all functions of
undefined
Embed recent and future Supply Planning systems
Manage Canadian Inventory profile of over $50M
Partner with both Diageo and 3rd Party Manufacturing with a Supply Plan that delivers the Canadian Sales plan

Experience / Skills Required

Experience & Qualifications:

Preferred MBA or business degree.
Minimum of 10 years' experience in operations and supply chain management.
Demonstrated knowledge of supply chain strategy development and execution.
Proven ability to influence and network within a matrixed organization.
Comfortable working through ambiguity and being the leader to set direction and vision

Strong leadership skills with experience in building, managing, and evolving teams;

credibility at senior levels is essential.

Innovative problem-solving abilities to address business challenges.
Expertise in Advanced Planning Systems (APS) and ERP systems (SAP preferred).

Thorough understanding of forecasting and inventory planning processes; knowledge of

MPS/MRP (Master Production Schedule/Material Requirements Planning) and DRP

(Distribution Requirements Planning) methodologies is beneficial.

Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re

supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:

Our purpose is to celebrate life, every day, everywhere. And creating an inclusive culture, where everyone feels valued and that they can belong, is a crucial part of this.

We embrace diversity in the broadest possible sense. This means that you’ll be welcomed and celebrated for who you are just by being you. You’ll be part of and help build and champion an inclusive culture that celebrates people of different gender, ethnicity, ability, age, sexual orientation, social class, educational backgrounds, experiences, mindsets, and more.

Our ambition is to create the best performing, most trusted and respected consumer products companies in the world. Join us and help transform our business as we take our brands to new heights and build new ones as part of shaping the next generation of celebrations for consumers around the world.

Feel inspired? Then this may be the opportunity for you.

If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.

Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.

jobs.title: LoanIQ - VP, Business Analysis
jobs.description:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Analyst with strong LoanIQ (LIQ), ACBS and/or other core lending platform expertise and Vice President-level experience in lending operations, product, change delivery, or business transformation. This role will be responsible for driving business analysis, target operating model design, requirements management, migration support, and cross-functional delivery for LoanIQ, ACBS, legacy loans platform and other loans – peripheral systems related initiatives across agency, syndicated, and commercial lending products.

The ideal candidate will bring deep knowledge of the end-to-end lending lifecycle, strong stakeholder management skills, and hands-on experience translating business needs into clear functional requirements for technology and operations teams. This individual will operate at a senior level, partnering closely with Operations, Technology, Product, Finance, Risk, front-office stakeholders, vendors, and system integrators to support LoanIQ implementation, migration, enhancement, and optimization initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Lead business analysis activities for LoanIQ (LIQ) / ACBS / legacy loans platform initiatives, including implementation, migration, platform enhancement, and operating model transformation.
Partner with business, operations, and technology stakeholders to define current-state processes, identify gaps, and design future-state workflows.
Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements, functional requirements, process flows, and data requirements.
Support development of Target Operating Model (TOM) deliverables, including process design, roles and responsibilities, control points, and business capability mapping.
Act as a key liaison between business users, operations teams, technology teams, vendors, and front-office stakeholders to ensure requirements are understood and delivered accurately.
Spearhead analysis supporting the decommissioning of legacy loan platforms, including data mapping, migration, reconciliation, and cutover readiness activities.
Identify, document, and prioritize continuous system enhancements to optimize LoanIQ capabilities and address complex lending requirements.
Partner directly with external vendors and system integrators to ensure deliverables align with internal project milestones and business expectations.
Support solution design discussions and help assess upstream/downstream impacts, integrations, and operational dependencies.
Drive workshops with stakeholders across lending operations, agency services, servicing, finance, accounting, settlements, and risk/control functions.
Translate business requirements into detailed user stories, functional specifications, and testing scenarios for development and QA teams.
Support UAT planning and execution, including test case review, defect triage, business validation, and go-live readiness.
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes across the lending lifecycle, reducing operational risk and improving service delivery.
Provide and lead business support activities for LIQ, ACBS, legacy loans platform and other peripheral systems, as needed.
Assist in issue management, risk tracking, dependency management, and status reporting for senior governance forums.
Lead and mentor junior analysts within the workstream, providing guidance on LoanIQ functionality and project delivery best practices.
Deliver executive-level presentations and updates to senior leadership, including project milestones, risks, and key achievements.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Economics, Technology, or related field.
10+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Operations Change, or Project Management within Corporate / Investment Banking.
Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience with Finastra LoanIQ, ACBS and/or other core Lending platforms
VP-level experience in Business Analysis, Lending Operations, Product, Change Management, or related banking functions.
Strong hands-on experience with LIQ, ACBS or other core lending platform in a business, operational, product, or change capacity.
Deep understanding of commercial lending, including syndicated loans, bilateral loans, agency servicing, trading, and secondary loan markets.
Proven experience supporting or leading large-scale system implementations, particularly migration from legacy platforms to vendor solutions.
Strong experience writing business requirements documents (BRDs), functional specifications, process maps, gap analyses, and UAT documentation.
Strong knowledge of the end-to-end loan lifecycle, including origination, servicing, rollover, rate setting, fee processing, payments, notices, and settlements.
Strong stakeholder management experience with the ability to engage senior leaders, business users, and technology teams effectively.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, written, verbal, and presentation skills.
Experience defining creative solutions to meet business needs.
Experience in creating training plans and training materials and in training Operations on functionalities developed by IT.

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of hands-on experience with LoanIQ, FIS ACBS and/or legacy Loans platforms
Experience in Target Operating Model design and business process re-engineering.
Knowledge of agent bank operations, lender servicing, primary/secondary loan trading, and fee processing.
Experience with data mapping, conversion, interfaces, and reconciliations between LoanIQ and surrounding applications.
Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
Exposure to tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Visio, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Experience working with global teams across Operations, Technology, Product, and Change.
Knowledge of control, audit, risk, and regulatory considerations in lending operations.
Knowledge of various application functionalities that translate across products.
Ability to identify and assess near-term business needs and advise business and technology on options and benefits.

Core Skills

LoanIQ / LIQ subject matter expertise
Business analysis and requirements gathering
Process mapping and gap analysis
Lending operations knowledge
Legacy platform migration support
Data mapping and reconciliation
Stakeholder and workstream leadership
UAT and testing support
Process improvement and automation
Executive communication and presentation skills

What Success Looks Like

Requirements are captured clearly and translated into actionable deliverables for technology and operations teams.
Legacy platform migration activities are supported effectively, with strong focus on data mapping, reconciliation, and operational readiness.
Future-state processes are well designed, controlled, and aligned to business objectives.
Stakeholders across business, operations, technology, and vendors remain aligned throughout the delivery lifecycle.
LoanIQ/ACBS/Legacy loans platform/other Peripheral system solutions are implemented or enhanced with strong operational readiness and minimal disruption.
Risks, issues, and dependencies are proactively identified and managed.

The typical base pay range for this role is between $176K - $215K depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. This role may also be eligible for certain discretionary performance-based bonuses and/or incentive compensation. Additionally, our Total Rewards program provides colleagues with a competitive benefits package (in accordance with the eligibility requirements and respective terms of each) that includes comprehensive health and wellness benefits, retirement plans, educational assistance and training programs, income replacement for qualified employees with disabilities, paid maternity and parental bonding leave, and paid vacation, sick days, and holidays. At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible
